regions.contentLimits: One small administration link outside the phone frame.
regions.overflow: The link stays outside the frame at every viewport width.

regions.contentLimits: One dark-graphite phone frame with a picture-first Nature cover, screen-filling gap-free two-column galleries, two Friendly Faces upload slots, a breathing cue, RUST gateway links, and a final-page multi-line one-liner input.
regions.overflow: The active screen scrolls within the phone. Gallery tiles stay in two columns without captions or gaps, except for empty upload guidance.

responsive.compact: The phone frame fills the available viewport with the Admin link outside its upper edge.
responsive.wide: The phone frame stays centered at the phone container width while the Admin link remains outside it.

focus.onError: Local image and storage failures are announced without moving focus.

accessibility.headings: The phone exposes one level-one heading for the current screen. Navigation moves focus to that heading.
accessibility.labels: Every image upload, cover action, navigation action, gateway link, and final-page one-liner action has a programmatic label. Uploaded image file names supply temporary alternative text.
accessibility.statusAnnouncements: File and local-storage failures use an alert. The one-liner save result uses a polite status message.
